bands-bodyweight-20-travel-no-weights-02.title: Bands & Bodyweight 20 – Travel (No Weights)
bands-bodyweight-20-travel-no-weights-02.description:
Nach dem Lauf.

Lower-body and hip routine for travel days or when you have no equipment – keeps glutes, hamstrings and calves strong.
Format: 3 rounds as a circuit.
Focus: quality over speed, pelvis level, knees in line with the toes.

No weights needed – only a mini band (or long band). Choose a band so the last 2–3 reps feel hard (RPE 6–7); without a band slow the tempo down (3 s down, 1 s pause).
Rest: 30–45 s between exercises, 60–90 s between rounds.
Feel: glutes and legs burning, never sharp pain.
Duration: approx. 20 min.

Gewicht selbst anpassen – an dein Niveau und die vorgegebene RPE. Gefordert, aber nicht platt.

exercises.title: Banded Monster Walk
exercises.notes: Half squat, small steps, band tension the whole time.

exercises.title: Single Leg Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Full range, 2 s down.

exercises.notes: Pelvis still.

mep-week-1-5c877a71.title: MEP Week 1
mep-week-1-5c877a71.description:
Muscular Endurance nach dem Berg.

Read the description every week! Load, rest times and other parameters do change! 

This workout builds muscular endurance, fatigue resistance, and joint durability for ultra running. Split Squats and Box Step-Ups load the legs unilaterally with long time under tension, closely matching how muscles work late in long races when elastic energy is reduced and fatigue is high.
The goal is not maximal strength, but to increase the fatigue resistance of a larger portion of muscle fibers, including fast-twitch fibers that normally fatigue early. Over time, these fibers adapt to work more aerobically

Gewicht selbst anpassen – an dein Niveau und die vorgegebene RPE. Gefordert, aber nicht platt.

exercises.notes: Run 20 min. Final 3 min go into Zone 3 to finish this run with a light sweat

exercises.notes:
8 sets of 10 Split Jump Squats (each leg)
*Rest 1 minute between sets
*After  take 3 minutes of active recovery before moving to next series 
Add 10% of your Body weight in form of DB or weight vest to it.

exercises.notes:

*After the sets, take 3 minutes of active recovery

post-run-meditation-1cd37bd1.description:
Nach dem langen Lauf.

15-Minute Post-Run Meditation
Find a comfortable seated position and press play on the meditation track. Begin by slowing your breathing with the 4-7-8 technique: inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 7 seconds, and exhale slowly for 8 seconds.
Allow your body to relax and your heart rate to settle. As thoughts arise, simply acknowledge them and let them pass without judgment. There is no need to force anything—just be present.
Bring your awareness to your body. Notice your muscles, your breathing, and the feeling of calm spreading through you. Focus on gratitude, positivity, and the energy you want

upper-body-20-bands-trx-bodyweight-iso-h.title: Upper Body 20 – Bands, TRX & Bodyweight + Iso (Home)
upper-body-20-bands-trx-bodyweight-iso-h.description:
Upper body + core with band, TRX and bodyweight, approx. 20 min, 3 rounds as a circuit.
Choose and adjust the band/resistance yourself: the last 2 reps should feel hard (RPE 6–7) with clean technique.
Rest: 30 s between exercises, 60 s between rounds.
Feeling: challenged, not exhausted.

Gewicht selbst anpassen – an dein Niveau und die vorgegebene RPE. Gefordert, aber nicht platt.

exercises.notes: Hold 2 s at the top.

exercises.title: Hollow Hold
